brief.headline: Push for ₹0.65–0.80/pc on PP caps (market says ₹0.55–1.20, typical ₹0.85–0.95) and extend payment to 45 days to free ₹1.82 L cash for us

priceAsk.summary: Ask for ₹0.65–0.80/pc on 28 mm induction-wad PP caps at higher volume
priceAsk.basis: Open-market asking price is ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typical ₹0.85–0.95/pc. Market verdict: MARKET-FAIR with modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume or looser spec. Our target sits at the lower end of that headroom band.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Move from 30 days after receipt to 45 days after receipt

brief.financialLeverage: Rachana Plastics publishes no financials, so we don't know their revenue, profit, or how tight their cash is. Our ₹44.37 L annual spend is meaningful but we can't judge how big a customer we are without their revenue figure. Because their finances aren't public, we build our ask on the market reference (caps trade ₹0.55–1.20, typical ₹0.85–0.95) and on having four strong backup suppliers lined up. Without visibility into their health, push firmly but keep the door open — we need supply continuity.

evidence.point: We spend ₹44.37 L a year with them on rigid plastic packaging
Market asking price for 28 mm PP caps is ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typically ₹0.85–0.95/pc
Market verdict says MARKET-FAIR with modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume or looser spec
Extending payment 15 days (30 to 45) frees ₹1.82 L cash for us
Four qualified alternates already on our list, plus six maker/recycler leads to explore

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter (₹2569.83 Cr revenue, health score B 65/100) — pharma bottles, caps, preforms; top second-source candidate

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader (₹946.50 Cr revenue, health B 73/100) for pails, containers, pharma — strong and profitable alternate for bottles and closures

alternates.name: IVL Dhunseri Petrochem Industries Private Limited (lead to qualify)
alternates.why: Manufacturer in India-East — a lead to qualify (verify before RFQ) for direct maker pricing

risks: Rachana publishes no financials — we can't see if they're healthy or stretched, so watch for signs of distress (delivery delays, quality slips) that signal trouble
Our current terms (30 days after receipt) are not the worst we give, so they may resist a longer stretch without a volume or spec trade-off
Market backups (Reliance, Srichakra, Dalmia, Ganesha, Chemco, IVL Dhunseri) are leads only — none are qualified or priced yet, so don't present them as ready alternates in the room
If we push too hard on price without knowing their margin, we risk a walk-away or a quality cut — keep the tone firm but collaborative
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We're spending ₹44.37 L a year with you on caps and bottles; the market shows caps at ₹0.55–1.20 with room to ₹0.65–0.80 at our volume, and we'd like to land there while moving to 45-day terms to help our cash flow.
